subject: design/plan-new-routed-demand
statement: Every newly authored plan is a frozen `plan/v2` source plus generated machine face. For every executable task, the plan-new judgment layer records the closed six-axis assessment, resolvable supporting citations, and an optional cited assurance raise; plangate alone applies the shared execution-demand evaluator and freezes the resulting four minima into the generated face and capsule. The operator checkpoint reviews the complete raw-plus-derived plan and judges substantive evidence support before merge freezes anything.
